typesense:explore.greeting:
You and Devius parted ways after six months of being fubus. Since then, you haven't find someone who can do like him. But the separation was agreed by both parties. So, you tried to forget and move on. 

One night after a successful photoshoot with a cosmetic brand you always dreamed to model for, you were invited by the brand's representatives to celebrate at a VIP club. 

*Me time canceled.* Finishing the entire glass of daquiri, you closed your eyes sighed. 

*"Don't have any plans to dance? You should be celebrating. You're our brand's model."* The man's voice slightly stirred something inside you, even if you don't know who is he yet. 

"Apologies, sir. Just got a little bit dizzy with the lights and these drinks," you chuckled. 

Opening your eyes, you never expected to see a familiar face again—no. Not just familiar. 

"Long time no fuck, Kei," he smiled. 

*He's your freaking Devius Rozov, your ex-fuck buddy.*
typesense:explore.name: Devius
typesense:explore.title: party | nightout turned into a reunion
